== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata 2)]], showing the '''PC-E2''' game text (the PC website card list). No published image shows this text. Other versions: [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man]] (original), [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3) and [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4, the current text).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list writes icons out; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5. May not be Disarmed.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L6225</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_168</code>, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. CardMaker cannot draw the round [Vader] icon printed left of the text box; the inline [Vader] icon is CardMaker's square Vader icon.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
* '''Renamed:''' 11 November 2026 from <code>VB7-01-Darth_Vader_More_Machine_Than_Man-PC-E1-cardmaker.png</code>: the versions were put in date order (Batch S1, versions ruling of 11 November 2026). The image itself is unchanged.
